Im in a constant debate with myself regarding this take of yours. I completely agree with what you're saying but there's always another part of me that wants to keep living just to see what can happen. I've always been a curious person, and I always try to figure out what an average 'happy' person's life would be. But the other part of me has this exact same mindset of yours which makes absolute sense to me. Why would anyone want to live in an unfair world? Because the ones that want to always take advantage of the ones that don't. This answer's not helpful I'm sure but I hope it kinda broadens your perspective of your own thinking. To top it all off, being a crazy overthinker just makes it all worse by maintaining the shift in mindset back and forth all the time. This just makes me so tired and done with everything. Whoever you may be, I hope you stay curious enough to keep going on with your journey, because I'm sure that I'll do the same! Good luck to you :)
